description: Single-tenancy food fit-out in a retail precinct; dimension plan, RCP and storefront elevation. Answer key for the autonomous AI tasks (Card P). Room areas are calibrated reviewer traces (printed-dimension calibration agreed within 0.22%), not independent survey values.

rooms.label: Bar
rooms.note: Confirmed by the project contact 2026-10-05: the Bar is the walled central island. Area measured to the inside faces of its drawn partitions on the dimension plan (calibrated 11,825 mm dimension), not independently surveyed; it equals the enclosed-walls measurement, so for Bar the score tests naming, not geometry.

rooms.label: Shop
rooms.note: Still pending: the walkthrough trace drew Bar in the wrong place, so Shop changes with it. Whether the top-middle buffet stations belong to Shop is not yet confirmed.

pages.evidence: Unlabelled north needle in a circle in the title block, pointing up the sheet.

edges.evidence: Storefront line; matches the 11,900 mm storefront elevation (p. 26). Whether it faces outdoors or an indoor mall is not yet known.

glazed_panels.note: Glass continues above the 2,700 mm ceiling; head capped at the ceiling.

P5_roof.evidence: Confirmed by the project contact 2026-10-04: apartments above the retail precinct. Not determinable from the plans alone.
